goal: Complete the UIGS epistemic rebase as an operational, reversible, evidence-governed learning system across the active knowledge lifecycle.
current_work_unit: Experimental knowledge epistemic triage and operational coverage
next_units: generate and review Experimental epistemic triage
model promotion-candidate Experimental knowledge as Claims without automatic promotion
create validation missions for evidence-poor Experimental knowledge
connect recurrence/counter-evidence to challenge or scope narrowing
close governance-reporting and active-learning coverage gates

completion_gates.description: Prior-art-grounded Claim/Evidence/Change model, reversible authority, dependency invalidation, and retrieval enforcement are merged.
All currently Validated legacy catalog records have first-pass Claim/Evidence representation.
Every Experimental catalog record is classified into a governed next action.
Promotion candidates are modeled at Claim/Evidence granularity or explicitly retained as aggregate views.
Evidence-poor or challenged Experimental knowledge has actionable validation/challenge work rather than remaining inert.
Epistemic state, Experimental triage, missions, and project completion state are durably generated and reviewable.

notes: Project state supersedes earlier milestone-level uses of status=completed.
A completed milestone or work package must not be reported as PROJECT_COMPLETE while required project gates remain unfinished.
